Two independent odd-degree counts determine their integer trace multiplicities. Independent exact finite-field projective enumeration via polynomial-quotient arithmetic gave #X(F2)=15, #X(F4)=205, #X(F8)=345, #X(F16)=7729, all matching the asserted parity formulas. For F2, weight-two projective points alone lie on X and all have vanishing derivative sigma4, proving no smooth point. Finite counts are used to determine unknown signs after the theoretical eigenvalue restriction, not extrapolated to all m.
